strategies.name: premarket_level_liquidity_sweep_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Mark the same pre-market high/low range. When price briefly breaks or wicks through the level but then reclaims it and closes back back inside/through the level, enter in the opposite direction of the failed break after that reclaim confirmation.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry candle. Target at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trim/scale out and move the stop to break-even or into profit while letting the remainder run until stopped or manually satisfied.
